Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed “The Bacchanal of the Andrians” to Nicolas Poussin instead of Titian. This misframed the “place where the artist died” as Rome (Poussin) rather than Venice (Titian), steering the investigation toward “why Roncalli left Rome” instead of the correct context (why he left Venice), which would lead to the correct answer “for the conclave in Rome.” Subsequent steps compounded this confusion, but the first error occurred in the initial assumption.
